branches.borderline: Keep the new memory/retrieval claim inconclusive.
branches.failure: Record a bounded memory/retrieval negative result.
branches.success: Report only a new memory/retrieval effect under its own protocol.

factor.ablation: Remove a memory cue under an independently justified intervention.
factor.actual_primary_control: Degree/self-loop/state-matched random-mask GRU, to be qualified for the new endpoint.
factor.executed_compute_matching: Match token and recurrent operation budgets.
factor.manipulation: Compare block and degree-matched random recurrence on a newly named memory endpoint.
factor.name: SYNTHETIC old-task memory transfer contrast
factor.prediction: A bounded recall outcome changes under the registered structural intervention.
factor.prior_art_boundary: Do not claim competing hypotheses from the old lookup task.
factor.state_matching: Match total recurrent state and retained readout state.

purpose: SYNTHETIC_DRY_RUN_DO_NOT_TRAIN: an EXP-0004-style task may support a distinct memory or retrieval question, not H3 semantics
question: Synthetic independent memory-retrieval question

task_search.heldout_rule: Hold out an independent seed and retain failed calibrations.
